open_points.subject: R0-89 disaster-recovery replay
open_points.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record of the retention review (R0-60).
open_points.question: What record is this, who creates and keeps it outside the lost store, what facts does it contain, and what happens when it is absent or incomplete?
options: A governance record identifies every action that must be repeated and its inputs
The owner reconstructs the actions manually from unspecified evidence
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a governance record kept outside Registry that identifies each affected record, action and required input.

open_points.subject: R0-89 scope of repeated changes
open_points.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record of the retention review (R0-60).
open_points.question: Are these three actions exhaustive, or must the owner also reconstruct other post-backup changes such as lifted restrictions, resumed relationships, corrections, project erasures, grants, revocations and pointer changes?
options: Only the three named actions are repeated
Every lost state change is reconstructed
Only retention-review actions are reconstructed, according to a defined list
open_points.default_guess: Repeat every retention-review action recorded outside the store, including inverse actions such as lifting a restriction or resuming a relationship.

open_points.subject: R0-89 restored-store availability
open_points.text: every change after it is lost ... What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record
open_points.question: May the restored Registry answer callers before lost erasures and restrictions have been repeated, thereby disclosing personal data that R0-06, R0-60, R0-65 and R0-67 say is gone or unavailable; and what observable event establishes that recovery is complete?
options: The restored store remains unavailable until required actions are repeated
It serves immediately and temporarily may disclose restored values
Only the owner may access it during reconciliation
open_points.default_guess: Keep consumer and agent access unavailable until the owner completes and confirms reconciliation.

open_points.subject: R0-89 repeated import
open_points.text: A store lost before a checked backup holds the import loses the import with it, and the import may then be made again.
open_points.question: After the VPS source has been retired and the one-time migration has ended, what named input remains available for the repeated import, and must it preserve the original selected projects, display names and aliases?
options: The original migration file is retained outside the Registry store and reused unchanged
The retired source is restored or retained long enough to export again
The owner may provide a newly produced file and make a new selection and renaming
The import cannot actually be repeated once the source and export are gone
open_points.default_guess: Retain the accepted migration file outside the Registry store and reuse it with the original selection and names.
